class.name: CgameRigIK
class.brief_description: Static IK helpers on plain positions.
class.description: [CgameRigIK] exposes the solvers used by the Cgame skeleton modifiers as static functions that operate on positions, for scripts and offline tools: analytic two-bone IK with a pole, FABRIK for a chain with optional joint constraints, an aim rotation with an angular limit and joint limit projection. Constraint dictionaries: [code]{"type": "cone", "angle": radians}[/code] and [code]{"type": "hinge", "axis": Vector3, "min": radians, "max": radians}[/code]; the first joint of a chain can use [code]"ref"[/code] as the reference direction.

method.name: aim
method.description: Returns the rotation that turns [param forward] towards [param target], limited to [param max_angle] radians.

method.name: fabrik_chain
method.description: Solves a chain with FABRIK. The first position stays fixed and bone lengths are preserved. [param constraints] has one optional entry per joint.

method.name: limit_direction
method.description: Projects [param direction] into the cone or hinge range around [param previous_direction].

method.name: two_bone
method.description: Solves a two-bone chain. Returns [code]mid[/code], [code]tip[/code] and [code]reached[/code]. Unreachable targets are clamped to full extension.
